annotations.title: Employer cost of a salary in Belgium

description: What a salary in Belgium costs the employer (employer social contributions itemised), or the reverse: the gross salary a total budget allows. Give gross_annual or budget_annual.

budget_annual.description: Total yearly employer budget in EUR, to find the gross salary it allows

expat.description: Expat regime (impatriate). For people recruited abroad earning at least €70,000. Default false.

married.description: Married or registered partner. Default false.

municipal.description: Municipal surcharge. Most communes charge between 0% and 9%. Look up yours on the FOD Financiën site. (%). Default 7.

spouse_income.description: Partner's gross yearly income in EUR, for joint taxation and spouse allowances. Default 0.
